userDecision: Nuvemshop products are real store products and must be preserved. Never infer test status from missing mappings, SKU, low/zero stock or product name.
limitations: Local snapshot is not real-time Nuvemshop stock or physical count. Stock buffer is reported, never subtracted automatically.
Configuration fields and log presence do not prove the current external integration is enabled, disabled or synchronized.
Product/variant stock equality is only an arithmetic check; product total is repeated per variant and must not be summed.
Modern unavailableStock/retiredAt may be absent in the source schema; missing values are not treated as zero or availability proof.
Only exact previously reviewed test IDs are separated; no catalog, links, stock or classification changed.
stockIntegrationMechanism: NOT_IDENTIFIED; user confirmed they cannot yet identify the current update mechanism

userClarification.meaning: The user cannot identify the current stock update mechanism; this is not evidence that synchronization is absent or disabled.

nextIntegrationEvidence: Identify existing routine/system and its owner without activating or replacing it
